title: Enhancement needed or Bug: Backup/restore feature works improperly

judgment.rationale: The author identified that the backup had been renamed to a name that does not match the existing settings_*.ptb convention and confirmed restoring works after renaming it to that convention. The thread therefore does not establish a remaining PowerToys defect.
evidence: The 2026-05-11 reporter comment explicitly identifies the renamed file powertoys_setting.ptb.
The same comment says renaming the file to settings_123.ptb made it work.
The related #32911 is a separate backup-and-restore feature proposal, not evidence that arbitrary filenames are currently supported.
judgment.recommended_action: Use the supported settings_*.ptb filename when restoring; no separate code fix is supported by this thread.

fix_assessment.rationale: No defect remains demonstrated: the reported file was renamed outside the established settings_*.ptb pattern. A code change to accept arbitrary filenames would be a separate feature decision, not a bug fix established by this report.

issue_context.summary: The reporter found that a renamed PowerToys backup file is not offered by Restore.
issue_context.known_information: The reporter says a generated .ptb backup was renamed to powertoys_setting.ptb and later was not detected.
issue_context.inferences: The current report concerns the accepted backup filename pattern, not failure to restore an unmodified backup.
issue_context.analysis: The latest comment clarifies that restoring worked after renaming the file to settings_123.ptb. That demonstrates a naming expectation mismatch rather than a remaining failure with the supported backup name.
issue_context.initial_investigation: Read the issue body and latest 2026-05-11 comment; compared with linked #32911 (feature proposal) and the reporter-linked dotfiles example. No independent failure is demonstrated.
